# Desk Space Al Reem Island — Aegis Coworking (full)

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM rents desk space on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Hot desks are AED 1,000 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150 per month and day passes AED 100.

This site (deskspacealreemisland.online) is a one-page guide to renting desk space and coworking desks on Al Reem Island, published by Aegis Coworking. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-07

## Key facts

- Location: Level 38, Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Hot desk (flexi desk): AED 1,000 per month — any open seat on the shared coworking floor, fibre-optic internet, meeting room credits, community events, coffee and tea; no licence address
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month (one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee) — own desk, 24/7 access, locker, extra meeting room credits, office address suitable for an ADGM licence
- Day pass: AED 100 per day — shared floor, WiFi, coffee and tea, print and scan, no commitment
- Private office: from AED 4,500 per month on the same floor
- No deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Tours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

## What is desk space on Al Reem Island?

Desk space on Al Reem Island is a seat in a shared, serviced coworking floor instead of a whole office. At Aegis Coworking on Level 38 of Addax Tower — inside ADGM — you can rent a hot desk for AED 1,000 a month, a dedicated desk for AED 1,150 or a day pass for AED 100, with WiFi, coffee and meeting rooms included.

## Hot desk vs dedicated desk

| Feature | Hot desk | Dedicated desk |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly price | AED 1,000 | AED 1,150 |
| Your seat | Any open desk | Same desk, every day |
| Access | Shared floor | 24/7 access |
| Storage | — | Dedicated locker |
| ADGM licence address | Not included | Included |
| Meeting rooms | Credits | Extra credits |
| Best for | Freelancers, no licence needed | ADGM startups & solo founders |

## A day at your desk

- 08:00 — Badge in on Level 38: Take the lift up Addax Tower and pick a seat on the shared floor — or head straight to your dedicated desk.
- 09:30 — Deep work, fast WiFi: Fibre-optic internet, quiet corners and big windows for the work that matters most.
- 11:00 — Client call in a meeting room: Use your monthly meeting room credits for calls and client meetings.
- 13:00 — Coffee & tea, on the house: Complimentary coffee and tea in the lounge — and a chance to meet other members.
- 15:30 — Print, scan, sign: Print and scan your documents without leaving the floor.
- 18:00 — Community events: Hot desk members get invitations to community events with other founders.
- 23:00 — Still going? 24/7 access: Dedicated desk and private office members can work any hour, any day.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much is desk space on Al Reem Island?

At Aegis Coworking in Addax Tower, a hot desk is AED 1,000 per month, a dedicated desk is AED 1,150 per month (plus a one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee) and a day pass is AED 100. ADGM government fees are separate.

Read more: [ADGM coworking cost in 2026](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-coworking-space-cost-2026)

### What is the difference between a hot desk and a dedicated desk?

A hot desk lets you use any open seat on the shared coworking floor. A dedicated desk is your own permanent desk with 24/7 access, a locker, extra meeting room credits and an office address suitable for an ADGM licence.

Read more: [Is a flexi desk enough for a solo business?](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-flexi-desk-enough-solo-business)

### Is Al Reem Island inside ADGM?

Yes. Addax Tower on Al Reem Island is within the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction, so a desk at Aegis is not just near ADGM — it is inside it.

Read more: [Is Al Reem Island part of ADGM?](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/is-al-reem-island-part-of-adgm)

### Can I use a desk for my ADGM licence?

Yes, with a dedicated desk. It includes an office address suitable for an ADGM licence application. The hot desk is for working only and does not include a licence address.

Read more: [Tech startup licence with a dedicated desk](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-tech-startup-licence-dedicated-desk)

### Do desk members get 24/7 access?

Dedicated desk and private office members have 24/7 access. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM.

### Is there a deposit or setup fee?

No deposit, no admin fees and no setup fees, with free registration. The dedicated desk has a one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee.

### Can I try the coworking space before committing?

Yes. A day pass is AED 100 and includes the shared coworking floor, high-speed WiFi, coffee and tea, and print and scan access — no lease and no commitment.

Read more: [Day pass coworking in Abu Dhabi](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/day-pass-coworking-abu-dhabi-your-flexible-workday-solved)

### Are meeting rooms included with a desk?

Hot desk members get meeting room credits, and dedicated desk members get extra meeting room credits every month. More hours can be booked when you need them.

### Can I upgrade from a desk to a private office?

Yes. Private offices start from AED 4,500 per month on the same floor, so you can move from a hot desk or dedicated desk without changing buildings.

### How do I book a desk or a tour?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 50 392 6316. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, and we can send a video walkthrough if you are abroad.
